_readme: THE STANDARD PLANNING SESSION — the process a mentor writes once and every tier
beneath inherits. Item 15.1, built from design/mockups/strategy-session-process.html,
approved by Mike 2026-09-21.
WHAT THIS FILE IS. The PLATFORM's standard session: the shipped default, which is the
mentor's own starting point and what a firm receives when nobody above it has written
anything. It is the base the cascade resolves against, exactly as
data/advisory-staircase.json is for the Advisory Staircase. A tier's OWN process is
stored as a firm-overlay config, never here.
WHY IT SHIPS FILLED. Decision A, ruled by Mike 2026-09-21: a handed-down step arrives
WITH ITS CONCEPTS ALREADY PLACED. Measured before the design: from a cold start an
advisor typed 5 of 5 step names and placed every card by hand. A named-but-empty step
removes the first cost and leaves the second, which is the larger one.
🔴 EVERY STEP NAME HERE IS MIKE'S, off the Pivot deck, and appears on the approved
drawing. Nothing in this file is written by us. `purpose` is DELIBERATELY EMPTY on
every step: it is advisor-facing wording and therefore his, authored on the mentor's
screen rather than invented here. An empty purpose is an unwritten one, never a
missing one.
🔴 ONE CONCEPT, ONE KEY, ONE STEP. Mike's ruling, 2026-09-21: a concept is listed
once, chosen once in Scope session, sorted once in Build session, and appears ONCE in
Run session and ONCE in the plan. A key may therefore appear in exactly one step of
this file, and the same concept may never be written twice under any spelling.
🔴 `items` HOLDS CARD KEYS, the same vocabulary the advisor's own steps are saved in —
the concept's own id, or `fw-<id>` where the concept has an approved framework card.
A concept with a framework card is drawn by THAT card and never also as a concept
card, so Porter's 5 Forces is `fw-porters-five-forces` and nothing else.
⚠ A KEY NAMING A CONCEPT THE ADVISOR DID NOT SCOPE IS SKIPPED, NEVER ADDED. Decision A
again: the scope ticked on Scope session is never changed by what is handed down. The
step arrives holding only what this client's scope already admits.
⚠ NO CLOSING BLOCKS. Decision D, 2026-09-21: Strategic Statements and the Action Plan
leave Build session entirely and belong to Objectives & actions. A `close-` key here
would put them back on the screen the ruling took them off.
